metadata.title: FSSAI Comprehensive Compliance Rules Database
metadata.governing_body: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
regulations_covered: FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations 2011
FSS (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulations 2011
FSSAI Draft Front of Pack Labelling (FOPL) Regulations 2023
metadata.penalty_framework: FSS Act 2006, Chapter IX — penalties up to INR 10 lakh + imprisonment

energy.regulation: FSS (Labelling) Regulations 2020, Schedule II, Part A

fat.regulation: FSS (Labelling) Regulations 2020, Schedule II, Part B

trans_fat_free.regulatory_limit_note: FSSAI Trans Fat Regulations 2022: max 2% trans fat in edible oils from Jan 2022
trans_fat_free.who_guidance: WHO recommends elimination of industrial trans fats globally by 2023

protein.regulation: FSS (Labelling) Regulations 2020, Schedule II, Part C

high_protein.note: Energy from protein must be >= 20% of total energy

sugar.regulation: FSS (Labelling) Regulations 2020, Schedule II, Part D; Clause 2.2.4

no_added_sugar.note: Product must not contain any ingredient that is a sugar or is derived from sugars, including sugar alcohols

sodium.regulation: FSS (Labelling) Regulations 2020, Schedule II, Part E

fibre.regulation: FSS (Labelling) Regulations 2020, Schedule II, Part F

vitamins_and_minerals.regulation: FSS (Labelling) Regulations 2020, Schedule II, Part G
vitamins_and_minerals.general_rule: A product can claim 'source of [vitamin/mineral]' if it provides >= 15% of RDV per 100g. 'High in [vitamin/mineral]' requires >= 30% of RDV per 100g.

multigrain.note: No FSSAI minimum % per grain — must genuinely contain multiple grain types

whole_grain.note: Must list whole grain as primary grain ingredient (first in list). Refined flour as primary disqualifies claim.

fresh.note: Cannot be used on UHT, retort-processed, or ultra-processed products (NOVA 4)

homemade.note: Misleading if mass-manufactured. FSSAI prohibits misleading claims under Section 53

health_claims.general_rule: Health claims must be substantiated with scientific evidence. Generic health claims allowed only for established nutrient-function relationships.

conditions: product contains probiotics or prebiotic fibres

bone_health.scientific_basis: EFSA approved nutrient-function claim for calcium + bone maintenance

immunity.note: FSSAI prohibits claims suggesting immunity boosting without specific approval. Permitted only for Zinc, Vitamin C, Vitamin D under strict conditions.

brain_health.note: Not an approved health claim under FSS regulations. Requires pre-approval from FSSAI.

energy_boost.note: Energy claims permitted for genuine high-carbohydrate/protein products. Cannot claim 'instant energy' for products with high GI sugars as a health benefit.

weight_management.note: Not approved under FSS Act unless the product is specifically formulated and licensed as a food for special dietary use (FSDU) for weight management.

requirements: Must be approved as Food for Special Dietary Use (FSDU) under FSS (Health Supplements) Regulations 2022
OR must carry 'not a medical food' disclaimer
glycemic index must be documented if claiming low GI

front_of_pack_labelling.regulation: FSSAI Draft Front of Pack Labelling Regulations 2023

star_rating_system.basis: Nutrient profile scoring: positive scores (fibre, protein) minus negative scores (sugar, fat, sodium, energy)

mandatory_allergens.note: All 8 major allergens MUST be declared on labels when present, even in small quantities

allergens.name: Peanuts
allergens.note: Peanut is a legume but treated as a tree nut allergen

may_contain_declaration.rule: If manufactured on shared equipment with allergens, must declare 'May contain traces of [allergen]'

additive_regulations.regulation: FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations 2011

artificial_colours.regulation_note: All permitted colours under Schedule I of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations 2011

prohibited_colours.name: Tartrazine
prohibited_colours.risk: Hyperactivity in children, urticaria, asthma cross-reactivity
prohibited_colours.eu_mandatory_warning: may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children
prohibited_colours.restricted_in_india: Cannot be used in products marketed specifically to children

prohibited_colours.name: Sunset Yellow FCF
prohibited_colours.risk: Hyperactivity in children, possible carcinogen at high doses
prohibited_colours.eu_mandatory_warning: may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children

regulated_preservatives.name: Sodium Benzoate
regulated_preservatives.interaction_risk: Forms benzene (carcinogen) when combined with Vitamin C (ascorbic acid)
regulated_preservatives.restricted_in: Children's products when combined with azo dyes

regulated_preservatives.name: Potassium Nitrite
regulated_preservatives.risk: Potential carcinogen formation at high temperatures

common_emulsifiers.name: Lecithin
common_emulsifiers.risk: Generally safe, but soy-derived — allergen concern

common_emulsifiers.name: Mono and Diglycerides of Fatty Acids
common_emulsifiers.risk: May contain trans fats if derived from partially hydrogenated oils
common_emulsifiers.note: Check source — if from PHO, contains trans fat

common_emulsifiers.name: Carrageenan
common_emulsifiers.risk: Potential gut inflammation, banned from EU infant formula
common_emulsifiers.eu_ban: Banned from infant formula in EU since 2018

artificial_sweeteners.name: Aspartame
artificial_sweeteners.risk: IARC Group 2B possible carcinogen (2023); contraindicated in PKU

artificial_sweeteners.name: Saccharin
artificial_sweeteners.risk: Previously linked to bladder cancer in rats; human risk at food levels not established

regulated_antioxidants.name: BHT
regulated_antioxidants.risk: Possible carcinogen; liver toxicity at high doses

regulated_enhancers.name: Monosodium Glutamate
regulated_enhancers.risk: Generally safe at food levels; rare sensitivity in susceptible individuals
regulated_enhancers.mandatory_declaration: Product labels must declare MSG if used

nova_classification.source: Monteiro et al., Public Health Nutrition 2019; WHO PAHO Nutrient Profile Model
nova_classification.note: NOVA is not an FSSAI classification but is referenced in FSSAI FOPL discussions and global health guidelines

nova_1.name: Unprocessed or Minimally Processed Foods
nova_1.description: Natural foods with no industrial processing or minimal physical processing

nova_2.name: Processed Culinary Ingredients
nova_2.description: Substances extracted from foods for use in cooking

nova_3.name: Processed Foods
nova_3.description: Products made from NOVA 1 + 2 with simple processing

nova_4.name: Ultra-Processed Foods
nova_4.description: Industrial formulations from multiple ingredients, many never used in home kitchens

required_on_all_labels.description: True name of the food — generic name or coined name with description

required_on_all_labels.format: Descending order by weight at time of manufacturing
Best Before DD/MM/YYYY or Best Before End MM/YYYY
required_on_all_labels.note: Use by date required for perishable products

required_on_all_labels.description: Full postal address of manufacturer in India or importer for imported products

required_on_all_labels.veg_symbol: Green filled circle inside green square
required_on_all_labels.non_veg_symbol: Brown filled triangle inside brown square

required_on_all_labels.description: Contact number or address of manufacturer for complaints

conditional_declarations.required_when: product contains wheat, rye, barley, oats or derivatives

conditional_declarations.format: Excessive consumption may produce laxative effects
High Caffeine Content: Not recommended for children, pregnant women, or caffeine-sensitive individuals

prohibited_ingredients: partially hydrolysed proteins without allergen declaration

100_percent_juice.condition: no added water, no added sugar, no concentrates reconstituted above original juice

fruit_drink.note: If juice content < 10%, cannot use the word 'juice' prominently

permitted_mineral_claims.mineral_water: naturally contains minerals from protected source
permitted_mineral_claims.packaged_drinking_water: no specific mineral content claims without testing

edible_oils.mandatory_declaration: trans fat content must be declared on label
prohibited_claims: cholesterol free if saturated fat > 1.5g per 100g

health_supplements.mandatory_disclaimer: This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease
health_supplements.required_registration: FSSAI product approval required for novel ingredients
health_supplements.maximum_nutrient_levels: Cannot exceed UL (Upper Intake Level) per serving

prohibited_claims.regulation: FSS (Labelling) Regulations 2020, Regulation 5; FSS Act 2006, Section 53

absolutely_prohibited.applies_to: all foods except licensed medical foods
absolutely_prohibited.penalty: Up to INR 5 lakh per offence

absolutely_prohibited.condition: when product contains artificial additives, colours, or preservatives
without documented clinical evidence and FSSAI approval

misleading_marketing_practices.description: Listing sugar under multiple aliases to artificially lower its apparent position in the ingredient list
misleading_marketing_practices.example: Sugar, Corn Syrup, Dextrose listed separately instead of combined sugar total

misleading_marketing_practices.description: Setting unrealistically small serving sizes to make nutrients appear lower
misleading_marketing_practices.example: Declaring 200g product in 4x50g servings to make sugar appear half

misleading_marketing_practices.description: Prominent front-of-pack claim contradicted by ingredient list or nutrition table
misleading_marketing_practices.example: 'No Added Sugar' on front but dextrose in ingredient list

misleading_marketing_practices.description: Use of natural imagery, green colour, leaf graphics to imply naturalness without being natural

diabetics.reference: American Diabetes Association Standards 2024; ICMR NIN 2024

children_under_12.marketing_restrictions: HFSS foods cannot be marketed to children under 16 per FSSAI draft 2023
children_under_12.reference: FSSAI Draft Regulations on Junk Food Marketing to Children 2023

pregnant_women.reference: ICMR NIN Dietary Guidelines for Pregnant Women 2024

LABEL_DECEPTION.description: Numerical threshold not met for claimed nutrient level

INGREDIENT_CLAIM_VIOLATION.description: Ingredient-based claim contradicted by ingredient list
examples: No Added Sugar when sugar aliases present

PROHIBITED_CLAIM_VIOLATION.description: Use of explicitly prohibited claim categories

COMPARATIVE_CLAIM_VIOLATION.description: Comparative claim made without sufficient reduction vs reference product

MISLEADING_CLAIM.description: Claim that is technically not false but creates a misleading impression
examples: Cholesterol Free on vegetable oil — plants never contain cholesterol

CERTIFICATION_MISSING.description: Claim requiring third-party certification (organic) made without certified status

DECEPTIVE_PRACTICE.penalty_range: INR 10 lakh + criminal prosecution under FSS Act Section 59

ADDITIVE_VIOLATION.description: Use of prohibited additive or exceeding permitted levels
ADDITIVE_VIOLATION.penalty_range: INR 5 lakh + product recall + FSSAI notice

ALLERGEN_UNDECLARED.description: Mandatory allergen not declared on label
